texts.preamble: Shantilal Dahyabhai Vora vs Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation & on 12 August, 2015 Author: Mohinder Pal Bench: Mohinder Pal R/Scr.A/2874/2011 Cav Judgment
texts.facts: 3. Facts giving rise to this petition are that the petitioner was convicted by learned Metropolitan Magistrate, Court No.8, Ahmedabad in Criminal Case No.4383 of 2008 vide order dated 18.5.2010 for the offence punishable under section 7 (2) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and imposed punishment to remain present in the Court till rising of the Court and also imposed fine of Rs.4,000/-, in default to undergo imprisonment for seven days. When the proceedings started before the trial Court afresh, prosecution moved an application that examination-in-chief of their witnesses recorded earlier be taken into consideration while HC-NIC Page 2 of 5 Created On Fri Aug 14 12:50:34 IST 2015 conducting fresh trial as per the directions of this Court. This application was opposed by the original accused on the ground that decision on the basis of examination-in-chief recorded earlier will adversely affect the rights of the accused.
texts.arguments: Aggrieved from this order, petitioner has preferred present petition on the ground that petitioner will be deprived of his valuable right in case the examination-in-chief recorded in the Court is relied upon by the prosecution. 6. Main grievance of the petitioner in this case is that the witnesses earlier examined by the prosecution be summoned in the Court and their evidence be recorded afresh as, while remanding this case, there were directions of the High Court for fresh trial.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Aggrieved from this order, petitioner has preferred present petition on the ground that petitioner will be deprived of his valuable right in case the examination-in-chief recorded in the Court is relied upon by the prosecution. 6.
